description: VYBE MUSIC v4.1.3 — Listen Together Beat Sync Same-Time Precision & Bass Boost, In-App Update Dialog with changelogs on home page, Admin portal cleanup & operator email fix, and host-only song stability.

changelog.title: Listen Together Beat Sync Precision & Punchy Bass Boost
items: Same Time Exact Accuracy: Tightly tuned drift thresholds (120ms snap seek, 20ms micro-adjust) and 1s high-precision heartbeats ensure both phones play at the exact same millisecond with zero audible echo
Beat Sync Bass Boost: Hardware-accelerated low-frequency bass boost synchronized across connected phones for powerful, punchy party sound
Dedicated Bass Boost toggles in Room Controls and Settings for both Host and Guest listeners

changelog.title: In-App Update Dialog on Home Page
items: Automatic home page update popup displaying App Name (VYBE Music), version number, and structured bullet-point changelogs
Two-action control: 'Update Now' navigates directly to updater for instant download, while 'Later' cleanly dismisses dialog for the session
Seamless background GitHub release & version.json checks with zero UI latency

changelog.title: Admin Portal Cleanup & Member Improvements
items: Admin Portal Cleanup: Cleaned up Admin screen by removing the registration guide card for a streamlined administrative workflow
Fixed admin email display bug: portal operator email (admin@vybemusic.app) is strictly filtered out from the Registered Members list
Rich Google Member Cards: displays Google profile avatar, display name, verified Google badge, registered email, and active device indicator
